Design system.

How Mira® looks, speaks, and moves. Every swatch, specimen, and component on this page is built from the live tokens and presets in this file. Change a token and this page follows.

One system. Every new page.

Type /design-system in the Agent panel with your prompt to create a new page based on this design system.

Recommended model: GPT 5.6 Sol or above.

Mira® · September 2026

(02)

Typography

Two voices. Mona Sans — condensed, heavy, uppercase — does the talking. Switzer Semibold — small, lowercase, relaxed — does the explaining. Smooch signs the guestbook. Written lowercase with a terminal period; the presets set it in caps.

H1 90 · Mona Sans Bold · condensed 75 · 90 → 70 → 50 · line 90% · track −0.02em · ss07

Refuse to blend in.

H2 80 · 80 → 60 → 45 · line 90%

Uppercase 30 · 30 → 27 → 23 · line 115% · quotes

Uppercase 23 · 23 → 21 → 19 · line 115% · section intros

Everything you need to look established.

Uppercase 17 · fixed · line 120%

Selected works (6)

Lowercase 15 · Switzer Semibold · line 140% · track −0.03em

Each service is priced and scoped before we start, so you always know exactly what you’re getting and when it lands.

Lowercase 13 · line 140%

We build brands for founders who refuse to blend in — identity, sites, and direction under one roof.

Lowercase 12 · line 115% · captions

Every number tells a story.

CMS pages mirror this scale at reading size: H1 80, H2 40, H3 25, and CMS Body at 15 with a 145% line.

(03)

Shape & surface

Corners are superellipse squircles, not plain rounds. Dark surfaces separate light cards with 3px seams, so edges read as grout lines instead of borders.

12px · 50% squircle — every card and container

10px on nested media — concentric radii

3px seams over Black — the grout system

100% radius only for small UI — plus, dots, spinner

(04)

Layout

One rule governs the edges: content always sits 33px from the viewport — pad 33px directly, or 30px inside a 3px seam. On phone the line moves in to 23px (20px + seam). Seams stay 3px at every breakpoint.

(05)

Motion

Three easings, each with one job. Nothing moves without a reason, and nothing uses a curve that belongs to another role.

Structural

cubic-bezier(0.87, 0, 0.13, 1) · 0.46s

Variant swaps, card open and close. An aggressive in-out — surfaces snap into place.

Reveal

cubic-bezier(0.21, 0.61, 0.35, 1) · 0.6–1.1s

Text and appear effects. Lines rise 15px and fade in as they enter view, tokenized per line.

Entrance

spring · 1.2s · staggered 1.05–1.55s

Hero elements on page load, arriving one after another.

(06)

Components

The working set. Every reusable component in the file, shown in its default state. Use these as instances; do not detach or rebuild them. Buttons stay black-on-light; labels and data live on dark surfaces, always with the red accent doing the counting.

FAQ Accordion

What's the difference between monthly and per project?

A project has an end date. We build the brand and the site, hand it over, and it's yours. Membership is for what comes after, or instead of it. $4,500 a month keeps one active request moving, and you pause any month you don't need us.

Is that the final price?

It's a real starting number, not a teaser. Scope is the only thing that moves it: an extra page, a second brand direction, a deadline that needs two of us. We lock the figure on the first call and it holds from there.

How long will it take?

Two to four weeks for a single piece of work, four to six for a full brand and site. We only take two clients a month, so your start date is real rather than a spot in a queue.

Who actually does the work?

The founder. You hire Mira, you get Mira. No juniors, no handoffs, no account manager relaying your feedback.

What do you need from me to start?

A short brief and someone who can make decisions. The clearer you are on the goal, the faster we move.

Do you offer support after launch?

Every build ships with 30 days of post-launch support. After that, membership keeps us on call at $4,500 a month. Cancel it the month you stop needing us.
